basic_info.description: Set in the Dolores Heights neighborhood of San Francisco, 332 Hill Street is a sophisticated modern residence that celebrates light, space, and sweeping views. This architectural three-bedroom + office, three-bathroom home (rebuilt in 2005) exemplifies contemporary design at its finest. The main level's soaring ceilings give dramatic effect to the home while large windows bring in morning and afternoon sun to the expansive great room and kitchen. Clean lines, a neutral palette, and high-end finishes offer a serene backdrop for daily living. The primary suite with walk-in closet, large primary bath and attached terrace offer a quiet refuge in the home. The open floor plan enhances the home's grand sense of space and creates an effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle coupled with a large garden terrace and mature garden. A formal dining room, guest suite, office, and laundry room addthoughtful versatility.
